Run the flexynesis CLI (inference mode)

Source: R/flexynesis.R
run_flexynesis_inference.Rd

Predicts on a test-only cohort using a model + artifacts produced by run_flexynesis. Inference forces CPU inside flexynesis and reuses the exact features and scalers stored in the artifacts, so the feature selection flags do not apply here.

Usage

run_flexynesis_inference(
  pretrained_model,
  artifacts,
  data_path_test,
  outdir,
  surv_time = "overall_survival",
  surv_event = "status",
  prefix = "job",
  safetensors = FALSE,
  extra_args = character(0),
  conda_env = "flexynesisenv",
  conda_path = NULL
)

Arguments

pretrained_model

Path to .final_model.pth / .safetensors.

artifacts

Path to .artifacts.joblib / .artifacts.json.

data_path_test

FLAT folder with clin.csv + omics CSVs (see export_flexynesis_data with layout = "flat").

outdir

Output folder for predictions.

surv_time, surv_event

Survival column names. These MUST be passed: in flexynesis the predicted-labels block is gated by if any([target_variables, surv_event_var]), so without --surv_event_var inference stops after writing embeddings and never produces predicted_labels.csv.

prefix

Job prefix. Default "job".

safetensors

Logical; set if the model was saved as SafeTensors.

extra_args

Optional additional raw CLI tokens.

conda_env, conda_path

Conda environment / binary.

Value

Invisibly the path to <prefix>.predicted_labels.csv.
